The biggest bottleneck in AI inference today is memory. Chips can compute faster than they can be fed data, a problem known as the memory wall, and Netpreme is building the solution. Our approach spans the full stack, from a proprietary memory management library down to X-Mem™, our Memory Processing Unit (MPU) silicon. Netpreme was co-founded by researchers in optical networking and ML systems. We’re a small team in Cambridge, MA and Santa Clara, CA, and we’re looking for people who want to own hard problems end to end and help shape where the company goes next.

Serving frontier LLMs efficiently at scale is a moving target: every new model and workload reshuffles the tradeoffs across parallelism, batching, KV caching, and scheduling.
